_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/bloemenmarkt.json — RoomSpec for Bloemenmarkt (the city, district 2: the Munt): the quay along the Singel where the flower market floats: glasshouse stalls on their pontoons full of tulips and packets of bulbs, some shuttered, one open; souvenir and cheese shops across the street; the Munttoren at the end. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).
